chunks: If the hypocrites and those in whose hearts is disease, and the rumour-mongers of Madinah, do not desist, We shall rouse you against them, so they would not be able to live but a short time in the city with you.

key_terms.الْمَدِينَةِ: The city (specifically Medina in this context)
key_terms.الْمُرْجِفُونَ: The rumour-mongers, those who spread anxiety or news to cause fear
key_terms.الْمُنَافِقُونَ: The hypocrites, those who profess faith but conceal disbelief

ai.seo_question: Who are the three groups mentioned in Surah Al-Ahzab that the Prophet was commanded to deal with in Medina?
ai.summary: In the context of the consolidation of the Muslim community in Medina, this verse highlights the triad of internal threats: the hypocrites, those with spiritual disease, and the rumor-mongers. Shia exegesis often emphasizes the divine command for the Prophet to assert authority over these groups, ensuring political and spiritual purity within the city. The promise that they would not remain long underscores the temporary nature of their influence once divine support is manifested.
